milestones.title: Reviewed Waiver
milestones.joke: An exception that went through review.
milestones.when: forgejo: a `waive-*` pull request of the student's is merged in their fork

milestones.title: Not Yet, With a Date
milestones.when: verify: one of the student's assignments counts an exempt resource and has an unexpired Waiver exemption (checked every few seconds after the merge)

milestones.title: The Pipeline Did It
milestones.joke: Merged, then applied by Apply, not by you.
milestones.when: verify: an **Apply** (`main.yml`) run on the fork finished green (checked after the merge)
